name: animated-slider
title: Animated Slider
description: Drag a thumb to pick a value or a range.

props.name: theme
props.label: Theme
props.description: Colour palette. The fill, the handle and the value bubble take its primary colour.

props.name: mode
props.label: Mode
props.description: Light or dark version of the palette. Starts dark.

props.name: smooth
props.label: Smooth
props.description: The thumb moves in fine steps while dragging instead of jumping from step to step.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration
props.description: How long the fill takes to catch up when you click the track, in seconds.

props.name: bounce
props.label: Bounce
props.description: Springiness of the fill catching up. 0 means no overshoot.

props.name: elastic
props.label: Elastic
props.description: The track stretches when you drag past either end, then springs back.

props.name: stretchAmount
props.label: Stretch amount
props.description: How far the track stretches past its ends, in percent of the track width. Needs Elastic on.

props.name: labels
props.label: Values on rail
props.description: Shows the current value and the maximum on the rail.

props.name: thickenedSize
props.label: Thickened size
props.description: Track thickness while thickened, in Tailwind spacing units. Not used when Thicken on is Never.

props.name: rounded
props.label: Roundness
props.description: Corner radius of the track and fill.

props.name: marks
props.label: Step marks
props.description: Marks drawn at each step along the track.

props.name: showEdge
props.label: Show edge
props.description: Shows a handle at the end of the fill.

props.name: edgePress
props.label: While dragging
props.description: What the handle does while you drag it. Needs Show edge on.

props.name: edgeVariant
props.label: Style
props.description: Shape of the handle. Needs Show edge on.

props.name: bubble
props.label: Value bubble
props.description: When a bubble with the current value shows above the handle.

props.name: rollingNumbers
props.label: Rolling numbers
props.description: Numbers in the bubble, on the rail and in the readouts roll to the new value.

props.name: edgeSize
props.label: Edge size
props.description: Size of the handle. Needs Show edge on.
